scope: Model appearance references only; not scientific observation data
method: Original procedural geometry/materials informed by independently viewed official assembly photographs and the JPL press kit. No photogrammetry, manufacturing CAD, texture extraction, or NASA Eyes assets used.

images.used_for: Broad shield spacing, reflective inner faces, foil edge appearance and latch placement patterns
White exterior panel joints/latches, asymmetric equipment deck, blankets, harnesses and base band
images.limit: Solar array absent in this assembly photograph. Ground fixtures and test covers were not treated as flight hardware.

images.used_for: Reflective radiator surfaces, bands, struts and tape details
Black ribbed telescope housing, support framing and visible aperture-area topology

inferred_details: Inner shield radii/heights and exact gaps
Solar-cell count, mounting details and coverglass optics
Hidden bus geometry, cables, housings and labels
Fine surface roughness and manufacturing imperfections
reference_use: Educational visual study. Photo pixels, people, logos and clean-room reflections are not baked into model textures.
transport: Windows curl HTTPS with certificate verification enabled
review_status: Visual approximation; no engineering fidelity certification or indistinguishability validation
